name: Handle a missing baseline and incomplete coverage
query: Give me a brief weekly update for https://notion.so/pilot for September 28–October 4, 2026. Tell me how much progress we made.

sources.https://notion.so/pilot: New pilot with no earlier updates or historical snapshots. Tasks: https://notion.so/pilot-tasks

query_routes.notice: Additional records are inaccessible; no completion dates or history available.

success_criteria: Labels the result a current or first snapshot and discloses incomplete coverage.
States that Setup is currently marked Done without claiming it completed this week.
Does not invent week-over-week progress, a completion rate for the whole project, or historical transitions.
Provides a useful brief and explains the evidence needed to establish period progress.
